name: narration-prompter
description: Windows desktop narration prompter for audiobook and voiceover work.

scripts.build: npm run clean:electron && tsc -b tsconfig.app.json tsconfig.electron.json && vite build
scripts.prepare:self-contained: npm run build:whisper-sidecar && npm run stage:whisper-model
scripts.package:dir: npm run prepare:self-contained && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir
scripts.package:self-contained: npm run package:dir && npm run validate:self-contained && npm run smoke:whisper-sidecar
scripts.package:win: npm run prepare:self-contained && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis
